# --------------------------------------------------
# PDF READER
# --------------------------------------------------
<br>
def extract_pdf_text(uploaded_file):
<br>
    text = ""
<br>
    with pdfplumber.open(uploaded_file) as pdf:
<br>
        for page in pdf.pages:
<br>
            page_text = page.extract_text()
<br>
            if page_text:
                text += page_text + "\n"
    st.write("Uploaded File:", uploaded_file)
    return text
<br>
# --------------------------------------------------
# DYNAMIC PARAMETER EXTRACTION
# --------------------------------------------------
<br>
def extract_all_parameters(text):
<br>
    results = {}
<br>
    lines = text.splitlines()
<br>
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'([A-Za-z0-9\s]+)\s*[:\-]\s*([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*)'
    )
<br>
    for line in lines:
<br>
        match = pattern.search(line)
<br>
        if match:
<br>
            parameter = match.group(1).strip()
            value = float(match.group(2))
<br>
            results[parameter] = value
<br>
    return results
<br>
# --------------------------------------------------
# ABNORMAL DETECTION
# --------------------------------------------------
<br>
def detect_abnormalities(report_data):
<br>
    abnormalities = []
<br>
    for parameter, value in report_data.items():
<br>
        found = reference_df[
            reference_df["parameter"].str.lower()
            ==
            parameter.lower()
        ]
<br>
        if found.empty:
            continue
<br>
        min_val = found.iloc[0]["min"]
        max_val = found.iloc[0]["max"]
<br>
        specialist = found.iloc[0]["specialist"]
<br>
        if value &lt; min_val:
<br>
            abnormalities.append({
<br>
                "parameter": parameter,
                "value": value,
                "status": "LOW",
                "specialist": specialist
<br>
            })
<br>
        elif value &gt; max_val:
<br>
            abnormalities.append({
<br>
                "parameter": parameter,
                "value": value,
                "status": "HIGH",
                "specialist": specialist
<br>
            })
<br>
    return abnormalities
<br>
# --------------------------------------------------
# SPECIALIST RECOMMENDATION
# --------------------------------------------------
<br>
def recommend_specialists(abnormalities):
<br>
    specialists = set()
<br>
    for item in abnormalities:
<br>
        specialists.add(

<br>
    return sorted(
        list(specialists)
    )
<br>

<br>
def generate_summary(abnormalities):

        )

    return summary
